cli_args.text: Generate ONE mobile game UI panel FRAME ONLY, landscape wide rectangle. Minimal clean silver metal border, thin (~32px), subtle corner accents only, NO heavy gold filigree, NO blue gems, NO checkerboard, NO gray mosaic fill. The entire inner area (75% center) must be 100% transparent PNG alpha=0 — draw ONLY the thin outer border ring, absolutely nothing inside. No text, no cards, no buttons, no background scenery.
